ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast macro distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity (white) pixels and 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous region occupies the central 60% of the fluke area. High-contrast black margins delineate the entire trailing edge and lateral tips. A distinct vertical black column of low-intensity pixels extends from the median notch downward toward the fluke base, creating a bifurcated appearance in the central pigmentation field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated wide angle of approximately 110-115 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the total visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extensive high-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) are most pronounced on the right lobe (image-right) with irregular spacing ranging from 5 to 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the upper boundary from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a downward convex curve as the trailing edge terminates at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially clustered dark-pigmented circular spots (5-8 pixel diameter) localized on the white central field and more densely at the distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (low-contrast grey marks) detected on the inner quadrant of the left lobe (image-left).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jagged contouring and deep indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip (image-right), consistent with previous mechanical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique black columnar pigmentation streak at the fluke's central axis which transitions into a mottled, spray-like pattern of dark pixels toward the base.
